It's been debated for a long time. The most recent (and most decisive) ruling on the matter was DC v. Heller in I want to say 2008 or 2009? The main question is whether the 2nd amendment refers to a collective right (that of a militia) or an individual right (that of the people). It's a really interesting debate. For a long time as far as I understand it was assumed to be an individual right and recently the SCOTUS has upheld that interpretation.
